I implemented every function in `minidb/expr_eval.py`, and all 25 tests in `tests/test_expr_eval.py` pass. I didn't change the test file or run the rest of the suite.

I added one private helper, `_check_bool`, which raises `TypeMismatchError` for any operand that isn't a bool or NULL. `logical_not`, `logical_and`, `logical_or` and `where_matches` all use it.

Beyond the spec, `evaluate` raises `TypeMismatchError` if it is handed something that isn't one of the known expression types. `compare` does the same for an operator outside the six comparison operators.
